REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
PROPERTY PRESERVATION COMMISSION
TUESDAY - OCTOBER 29, 2019 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
City Council Chamber
AGENDA MATERIALS: Staff reports are available for public inspection at the Cerritos Sheriff''s Station/Community Safety Center, 18135 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA
90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1203. Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to
the Property Preservation Commission after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the Cerritos Sheriff''s Station/Community Safety Center at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: Public comments will be allowed on all Agenda items at the
time each matter comes up for discussion. The public comments portion of the
meeting will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five
minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of
appropriate responses, persons are requested to state their name and city of residence
for the record.

Public Hearing Items
A.
A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 13117 Briarwood Street, Cerritos, California, 90703, has an inoperable vehicle stored in public view, trash cans and debris stored in public view, a vehicle parked on an unapproved area, structure exteriors in need of repair, a lack of adequate ground cover, and oil stains on the driveway which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7044-021-003).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2019-78
B.
A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 11337 Abana Street, Cerritos, California, 90703, has trash cans stored in public view, structure exteriors in need of repair and paint, and a lack of adequate ground cover which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7034-004-011).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2019-79
C.
A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 18130 Antonio Avenue, Cerritos, California, 90703, has an inoperable vehicle stored in public view, and overgrown vegetation which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7022-013-015).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2019-80
D.
A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 12948 Dawn Drive, Cerritos, California, 90703, has inoperable vehicles stored in public view, a lack of landscape maintenance, and a lack of adequate ground cover which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7012-013-013).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2019-81
E.
A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 18327 Parkvalle Avenue, Cerritos, California, 90703, has a lack of landscape maintenance, a lack of adequate ground cover, and structure exteriors in need of repair and paint which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7023-014-011).
